note: EOA transaction. Calls increaseApproval on WBTC granting the maximum uint256 allowance to 0x559657c3e8acd2c8cfb73fdb3c43923b91ce9b6b, an attacker-controlled contract that drained 3 WBTC in a follow-up transaction. The spender is a deployed contract, not a bare EOA, so a spender-has-no-code heuristic does not catch this one; the unlimited allowance to an unrecognised contract is the signal. Fails R-4.5 immediately: a max uint256 ERC-20 approval is always functionally unlimited (§ 2.5). Also fails R-4.4, the spender being outside the expected target set (§ 2.4).
